# Pi

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Pi
```

## Description

The number 3.14159265..., the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. It is a float, and [Sin](Sin), [Cos](Cos) and [Tan](Tan) take angles in degrees, so it is mostly useful for converting to radians (`degrees * Pi / 180`).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Pi
Print 180 * Pi / 180
```

```text
3.14159
3.14159
```
